flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: No code sends an ID/mobile number to Payment Gateway. Similar: POST /plus-apply-suspension (ocmsadminapi SuspensionProcessingController + SuspensionProcessingHelper) creates an ocms_refund_notice row for PS-APP/CFA/VST on paid notices, and UraPgServiceImpl (ocmsadminprivateapi) sends AXS transactions to Payment Gateway for payment reconciliation, not refunds.
note: Status Removed. Not claimed. The word paynow does not appear in the six repos. A PLUS waive request does create a refund record (Sebagian), but officer approval, sending the ID/mobile to Payment Gateway and the PayNow process do not exist. Tickets: OCMS-DF-2026-075 (Closed) and OCMS-DF-2026-152 (Ready to DEV) touch refund id creation from PLUS; neither changes the verdict. Payment Gateway/PayNow: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The officer approves the decision to proceed with the refund
steps.detail: There is no proceed/approve decision for refunds. The OcmsRefundNotice entity (lines 19-62) has no status or decision column, the controller only has create and list, and the refund approval page (App.tsx:353-358) is inside a comment block. Same as OCMS46.2 steps 1 and 3.

steps.step: OCMS receives the request from PLUS to waive a paid notice
steps.detail: The PLUS request comes in through POST /plus-apply-suspension (SuspensionProcessingController.java:485). For refund PS codes (PS-APP/CFA/VST, read from standard code PS_REFUND_CODES, SuspensionProcessingHelper.java:120-123) on an already-paid notice, the helper creates an ocms_refund_notice row with a reason matching the PS code (lines 711-757) and returns refundNoticeId to PLUS. It stops there: there is no follow-up step to Payment Gateway. Sebagian because the story is Removed. Tickets OCMS-DF-2026-075 (Closed, refund for PS-APP on paid notices) and OCMS-DF-2026-152 (Ready to DEV, refundNoticeId held the receipt number) touch this step; security of plus-* endpoints depends on APIM, cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS sends the offender ID or mobile number to Payment Gateway
steps.detail: Nothing sends an ID or mobile number for a refund. The refund entity has no ID/mobile column (OcmsRefundNotice.java:26-58). The only gateway call, UraPgServiceImpl.sendAxsTransactions (line 113), sends AXS payment transactions to Recon/insertOcmsAxsTxn (application-prod.properties:106-107) for reconciliation, not a refund request. A grep for paynow across the six repos: 0 results.

steps.step: Payment Gateway checks for a PayNow account and automates the refund
steps.detail: This step lives on the Payment Gateway side, outside the six repos, so it cannot be verified (cannot verify from repo). On the OCMS side nothing triggers it (step 3) and nothing handles its result.
